definitions.gloss: conditional; with conditions; with strings attached
definitions.explanation: Describes something that is granted or valid only under certain conditions or restrictions, not unconditionally.

examples.japanese: {条件付|じょうけんつ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
{条件付|じょうけんつ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The hiring was decided with conditions attached.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{条件付|じょうけんつ}きな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、すべて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{項目|こうもく}→項目：04150_koumoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{署名|しょめい}して→署名する：22432_shomeisuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: This contract is conditional, so please review all items carefully before signing.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧ (condition) + ⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧ (attached, with). Indicates that something comes with restrictions or requirements. Common in legal, business, and administrative contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {条件付|じょうけんつ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{承認|しょうにん}→承認：03237_shounin⟧ (conditional approval)
- {条件付|じょうけんつ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}する→賛成する：05647_sanseisuru⟧ (to agree with conditions)
- {条件付|じょうけんつ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{釈放|しゃくほう}→釈放：14806_shakuhou⟧ (conditional release)
- {条件付|じょうけんつ}き{採用|さいよう} (conditional hiring)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {条件付|じょうけんつ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun (conditional ~)
- {条件付|じょうけんつ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (conditionally, with conditions)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無条件|むじょうけん}→無条件：13475_mujouken⟧: unconditional
- ⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧なし: without conditions (casual)

THE 〜{付|つ}き PATTERN:
The suffix ⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧ (with, included) is productive:
- ⟦{朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}き→朝食付き：07826_choushokutsuki⟧ (with breakfast included)
- {送料込|そうりょうこ}み (shipping included — similar concept)
